title: Physical
mission: Build adaptable physical literacy and safe movement practice.
reviewer_profile: Qualified exercise professional; aquatic/self-defence specialists where relevant.

title: Physiological
mission: Understand body systems, health information and healthcare decisions without self-diagnosis.
reviewer_profile: Qualified clinician or registered dietitian as appropriate.

title: Mental
mission: Build sustainable attention, habits and coping skills; recognise when support is needed.
reviewer_profile: Psychologist or appropriately qualified mental-health practitioner for clinical claims.

title: Emotional
mission: Recognise, interpret and respond to emotions with autonomy and care.
reviewer_profile: Psychologist; trauma-informed and safeguarding review where relevant.

title: Intellectual
mission: Reason independently, evaluate evidence, model complexity and learn transferable skills.
reviewer_profile: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

title: Social
mission: Build reciprocal connection, confidence, inclusion and social judgement without manipulation.

title: Relationships
mission: Develop consent-centred relationship literacy, conflict repair and caregiving skills.
reviewer_profile: Relationship counsellor, safeguarding specialist or sexual-health clinician as appropriate.

title: Communication
mission: Communicate meaning accurately, listen and negotiate ethically across contexts.
reviewer_profile: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

title: Financial
mission: Understand money, risk and stewardship; make informed fictional financial comparisons.
reviewer_profile: Qualified financial, legal or tax professional in relevant jurisdiction.

title: Professional
mission: Create, deliver and improve value responsibly across careers, enterprise and technology.
reviewer_profile: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

title: Artistic
mission: Develop observation, creative craft, cultural literacy and aesthetic judgement.
reviewer_profile: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

title: Happiness
mission: Explore flourishing and meaning without grading subjective happiness or imposing a life ideal.
reviewer_profile: Wellbeing researcher or psychologist for scientific/clinical claims.

title: Philosophical
mission: Compare worldviews, evaluate arguments and practise reasoned moral judgement.
reviewer_profile: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

title: Practical
mission: Develop safe household, emergency, outdoor and digital self-reliance within competence limits.
reviewer_profile: Relevant qualified trade, emergency, road or outdoor instructor; local rules review.

title: Leadership
mission: Lead with accountability, develop others and coordinate complex decisions ethically.
reviewer_profile: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

title: Civilisational
mission: Understand institutions, history, economics and infrastructure; evaluate competing interpretations fairly.
reviewer_profile: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.
